reader.requirement: At 1985 the identifier-1 operands are initialized one after another left to right (the later operand wins on shared storage, and a subscript in a later operand sees what an earlier operand stored), and within a group the affected elementary items are initialized in definition order, every occurrence included.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf13_04 runs a multi-operand INITIALIZE without overlap; overlapping operands in both orders, a subscript the statement changes and multi-level tables were added by the probes

probes.expected: identifier-1s set left to right so the last one on shared storage wins (GR6); INITIALIZE I TE(I) sets I first and TE(3) after it, as GR2's series of MOVEs; every occurrence of a two-level table in definition order
subordinate REDEFINES items R2, R3 (and R3A/R3B under it) and K3 excluded; an identifier-1 that has REDEFINES (R2, R3, K3) or sits under one (R3A, 01 WB REDEFINES WA) is initialized (GR4)

reader.notes: Bind builds one BoundInitialize per identifier-1 in source order and ExpandInitialize walks Children in declaration order, so the order is structural. INITIALIZE I TE(I) storing into TE(3) follows GR2's series of MOVE statements; 1985 states no earlier subscript evaluation for INITIALIZE.

edition-consulted.switches: refuses WITH FILLER (COBOL0830), TO VALUE (COBOL0831), TO DEFAULT (COBOL0832) and THEN REPLACING (COBOL0833) below 2002; the plain REPLACING form passes untouched
refuses the eight post-85 category words (NATIONAL, BOOLEAN, the pointer words...) below their edition; the five 1985 words are ungated
refuses a REPLACING item naming more than one category below 2002 (PB5180)
refuses identifier-1 described with or containing OCCURS DEPENDING ON below 2002 (1985 SR4)
the figurative-to-numeric MOVE edition rows per REPLACING NUMERIC/NUMERIC-EDITED sender
